event_confirmation: Company release (Business Wire, 2026-10-22, 'Source: Stoke Therapeutics, Inc.', reproduced at https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/STOK/stoke-therapeutics-webcast-conference-call-q3-2026): webcast and call Thursday 2026-10-29 at 4:30 p.m. ET for Q3 2026 business and financial updates. Prior prints released at ~4:01 p.m. ET with a 4:30 call (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/STOK), so session amc. Preview dated 2026-10-22 also lists the Q3 report (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/STOK/21315). TipRanks/Unusual Whales show stale projected dates (Nov 3, Nov 10) that the company release supersedes. No Q3 8-K item 2.02 filed before the print (EDGAR list checked 2026-10-29).
conviction_note: No usable option chain, so abs_move 9.0 starts from the 7.56% median reaction and is raised for a likely first disclosure of the H2-2026 pre-NDA meeting outcome and a ~20%-of-shares short; p_up 52 because the only print-relevant evidence I could source is mildly reassuring (partner reaffirmed the Q3 2027 readout on Oct 28, registry shows EMPEROR no longer recruiting anywhere) against a likely ATM dilution disclosure, and the decisive item, what FDA said at the pre-NDA meeting, is unknowable before the release. The findings sum (+0.8) and the scaled number (+0.36) agree in sign and are both small: this is close to a non-result on direction with a large absolute move.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus -$0.88 on revenue $8.3m (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-22, https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/STOK/21315); TipRanks -$0.92 (10 analysts), Benzinga -$0.94 / $6.9m revenue (https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/STOK/earnings, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/STOK/earnings-forecasts); HC Wainwright cut its own Q3 EPS to -$0.81 from -$0.74 (https://www.tickerreport.com/?p=13532298). Sources disagree, so the bar is not settled; every reported-quarter item is capped at 0. No company financial guidance exists. The stock trades on the regulatory path (pre-NDA meeting H2 2026, rolling NDA from Q1 2027, EMPEROR readout Q3 2027) and the runway claim ($420m pro forma, 'through potential U.S. commercialization in early 2028'), per the Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001623526/000119312526330537/stok-ex99_1.htm. My print_vs_bar estimate: Q2 opex $74.8m, revenue $9.3m, interest $3.8m gives ~-$62-64m net loss on ~66.0m shares, about -$0.95, ~4% wider than the -$0.91 midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest ~13.0m shares, 12.7 days to cover at the 2026-08-14 FINRA settlement (down from 15.8m / 27.7 days in July), per curvedtrading search snippet (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/stok/short-interest/, page itself 403, snippet_only); against 64.53m shares outstanding (10-Q cover, 2026-07-30) that is ~20% of shares, a crowded short. No Sept/Oct settlement found. Options: no usable chain (ATM legs not two-sided), skew unavailable; put/call open-interest ratio 14.81 on 10,859 total OI (baseline), i.e. open interest is overwhelmingly puts, consistent with hedged/short positioning. Tape: spot $26.44, -31% from 52w high, +18% from 52w low, October range $22.05-$27.22, down ~11-18% since the Aug 3 print (Earnings Whispers; https://unusualwhales.com/stock/STOK/earnings), run-up 5d +2.9%, 20d +1.7%.

findings.finding: The FDA pre-NDA meeting that Stoke guided for H2 2026 (to align on the data package, timing and the statistical analysis plan for the Q1-2027 rolling NDA) has not been reported as held or as having an outcome in any source I found; this print is the first scheduled point at which the company can disclose the outcome, and the preview flags secondary-endpoint (Vineland) handling and rolling-NDA timing as the line to watch. Direction cannot be sourced before the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Timeline lines have moved this name: the Jan 2026 timeline update (readout mid-2027) coincided with a -10.4% reaction around the Jan 12 event; the Q2 release slipped the readout to Q3 2027 and the stock is down ~11-18% since. The Aug 2025 print with Phase 3 design updates was +25%.
findings.why_not_priced: Its outcome is not public; the market can only price the probability. If a clean alignment were already in the price the stock would not be 31% off its high with a 14.8 put/call OI ratio and ~20% of shares short; if a problem were priced, the stock would not have bounced from $22.05 to $26.44 in October.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-22 names the pre-NDA outcome as the key watch item (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/STOK/21315). Shares no document with the next finding except the Q2 release.

findings.finding: Biogen, Stoke's ex-US partner, reported Q3 on 2026-10-28 (after Stoke last spoke) and still lists the zorevunersen EMPEROR Phase 3 readout in Dravet syndrome for Q3 2027, i.e. no further slip signalled by the counterparty a day before Stoke's print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last readout slip (mid-2027 to Q3 2027, disclosed with Q2) was followed by a ~11-18% decline into this print; reaffirmations have not been tested as a standalone line.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is public and repeats Stoke's own guide, so it lands inside what the company already guided. Its value is only that a fresh partner statement makes a second slip at this print less likely; a market expecting a slip would show it in a weaker October tape than the bounce to $26.44.
findings.independence: Stoke/Biogen EEC 2026 release (Sept, 4-year OLE data) also carries 'Data from the global, pivotal Phase 3 EMPEROR study anticipated in Q3 2027' (https://www.stoketherapeutics.com/wp-content/uploads/EEC-2026-Presentation-Seizure-burden-quality-of-life-and-overall-clinical-status.pdf); same company messaging, not independent of the guide.

findings.finding: ClinicalTrials.gov lists EMPEROR (NCT06872125) as 'Active, not recruiting' across all eight countries including China (status verified 2026-08, record last updated 2026-10-20, primary completion 2027-03), whereas the Q2 release guided China enrollment to complete only in 'H2 2026' and the last European patient in August 2026 - suggesting global enrollment is complete and can be reported as done at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2026 completion of the 162-patient US/UK/Japan cohort was received well (Simply Wall St 2026-08-20 commentary); no clean reaction to an enrollment line in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: A registry status field is not on the wire and the company has not announced China/Europe completion; it is an inference from the registry, and China/Europe data are not in the US NDA package, so its weight is small.
findings.independence: Q2 release guidance on China/Europe enrollment timing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001623526/000119312526330537/stok-ex99_1.htm); no independent confirmation.

findings.finding: The prior $150m ATM was essentially exhausted ($80.7m net through June 30 plus $65.7m net for ~2.1m shares after June 30, ~$31/share) and a new $200m Cantor ATM prospectus supplement was filed on 2026-08-03; with operating cash burn of ~$58m a quarter (6M operating cash use $117.2m), the Q3 10-Q will show whether shares were sold under the new program while the stock fell from ~$32 to $22-26. Shares outstanding read ~66.0m on AAII on 2026-10-29 against 64.53m on 2026-07-30.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug 3 print that disclosed the $65.7m post-quarter ATM to one investor reacted +7.1% as tagged (+2.4% if the print was effectively bmo), so ATM disclosure has not been punished on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount sold under the new ATM in Q3/October is not disclosed until the 10-Q; the share-count gap may be only the tail of the already-disclosed 2.1m. What the money buys answered: runway to the guided early-2028 launch, no going-concern language, so this is dilution at a lower price, not distress; shrunk because ~20% of shares are short.
findings.independence: 10-Q subsequent-events note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001623526/000119312526330557/stok-20260630.htm) and AAII share count 2026-10-29 (https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/549795-why-stoke-therapeutics-inc8217s-stok-stock-is-down-673); same financing fact, counted once.

findings.finding: Positioning is crowded short: ~13.0m shares short (~20% of 64.5m shares) with 12.7 days to cover at the 2026-08-14 settlement, and the baseline put/call open-interest ratio is 14.81 - any clean regulatory statement at this print meets a short base that needs ~2-3 weeks of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Largest prior reaction in the baseline is +25.0% (Aug 2025, Phase 3 path clarity), consistent with squeeze-amplified upside on regulatory clarity; downside prints were ~-10%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is visible to all, so it is not unpriced information; it is a reaction-function asymmetry. Stale (August) and from a snippet, so sized small.
findings.independence: Baseline options block (put/call OI 14.81, total OI 10,859), sealed 2026-10-29; independent source of the same lean.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with; the small positive lean cuts mildly against the 31%-off-high drawdown and the put-heavy open interest, which is acceptable only because the lean rests on a crowded short and a partner reaffirmation rather than on a call about the pre-NDA outcome, so p_up stays at 52.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (inside the guide): Biogen's Q3-2027 reaffirmation repeats Stoke's own guide, cut from +0.5 to +0.2.
Lesson 5 (inference, not a company number): the ClinicalTrials.gov enrollment-status read cut from +0.3 to +0.2.

Lessons 4 and 7 (financing is a question; crowded short shrinks a negative): asked what the ATM buys (guided runway to an early-2028 launch, no distress), and with ~20% of shares short cut the dilution finding from -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 5 vs lesson 7 on positioning: kept the crowded-short finding filed (the core wins on filing) but cut it from +0.7 to +0.5 because the short data are an August snippet.
Lesson 6 (bar unsettled across three sources): reported-quarter finding kept at 0; abs_move_pct and p_up unchanged (9.0, 52).
